tree.text: The term “Council” means the United States Interagency Council on Homelessness established in section 11311 of this title.
The term “Federal agency” has the meaning given the term “agency” in section 551(1) of title 5.

notes.text: Amendments2004—Par. (1). Pub. L. 108–199 substituted “United States Interagency Council on Homelessness” for “Interagency Council on the Homeless”.

ancestors.heading: UNITED STATES INTERAGENCY COUNCIL ON HOMELESSNESS
